query: I finally got around to planting those tomato seedlings I bought last week in the balcony planter yesterday, I’m so excited to see if they’ll bear fruit this summer. I also tried that new matcha latte recipe I saw on the food blog last night, it turned out way creamier than I expected, I even added a little honey and it was perfect. Oh, and my cat knocked over the small potted mint on the windowsill this morning, I had to spend ten minutes cleaning up the soil all over the floor.
